trades.name: True gap up long
trades.quote: A true gap up may be the safest long on Monday. Bulls want to find direct continuation higher to accept Friday’s spike. I generally think holding above 6729-6733 resolves to 6769-6775 but this would be a large move relative to the straddle for Monday so I wouldn’t assume it comes in one day (the straddle can be repriced so it is possible). If we get a true gap up, we simply follow the rules of trading true gaps (see the starter kit). I’ll rate this a B and the only reason it isn’t higher is because bulls have struggled on rips for some time and I hate chasing gap ups.

trades.name: Hold of 6714-6718 overnight
trades.quote: If 6714-6718 is holding all night then I am willing to take a long looking for 6726.75, 6729-6733 and a true gap up if bulls want it. This isn’t much of a dip as we closed ETH right there, so I don’t rate it higher than a B/B-

trades.name: Lower high short below 6714-6718 / Friday spike rejected
trades.quote: If price becomes trapped below 6714-6718 I am willing to be short, but will proceed with caution. I definitely will not take this as a breakdown short and immediately pile in short. I would want price to probably trade down to 6708 or so, see a weakish response (think a bear flag type pattern) and then consider a lower high short. This is something that will require supportive session information. The only reason I am willing to take it is because of the potential weekly rotation to 6687-6690 and because of what a loss of 6687-6690 has the potential to do. I see the weak backside structure below roughly 6707-6708 (red circle) and then I look down at the lower wicks (yellow circles) and see them as stops begging to be taken out. It will need to lose 6707-6708 so I don’t want to see a strong response off that spot if looking to be short as it could simply trigger a reclaim of 14-18 and be a long. If Friday’s spike is rejected, then things start to feel just a bit fishy and I’m willing to carefully take a shot. I see this as rather low probability, but high reward. For me this means sizing smaller. I can’t rate this higher than a B- even with the potential range because of the prevailing bullish trend. I would be taking profit more quickly and prepared to get flat or flip long.
trades.stop_hint: It will need to lose 6707-6708 so I don’t want to see a strong response off that spot if looking to be short as it could simply trigger a reclaim of 14-18 and be a long.

trades.name: LBAF of Friday's low (6687-6690)
trades.quote: A fresh LBAF of Friday’s low (87-90) still has to be a long given prevailing bullish trend and the weekly profile. Because of how well-tested this area is and the fact it would represent a potential rejection of Friday’s spike, I downgrade it relative to most days and give it a B-.

trades.name: True gap up long
trades.quote: I feel like NQ may have less room on a true gap up than ES so I would proceed with a bit more caution, but it remains a valid trade, rated slightly lower relative to ES so maybe a B-

trades.name: Hold of 24828-24839
trades.quote: Similar to the ES long on a hold of 14-18, it is reasonable to be long a hold of 828-839, making sure that 856.25 is reclaimed for a potential trip to 888. I’ll rate it the same as the ES trade B/B-.

trades.name: Short below 24828-24839
trades.quote: I’m less interested in getting short NQ below 828-839 as 790-800 needs to be lost to trigger a potential weekly rotation. It is valid, but riskier than the ES trade and there is no reason to think it has range until 790-800 is lost and offered. I won’t even rate it.

trades.name: Hold of 24790-24800
trades.quote: I am more willing to long a hold of 790-800 on NQ as it would be a 60 handle pullback from Friday’s close, bulls are in control, and it would be roughly a 50% retracement of Friday’s range. There is weak backside structure below so I can keep a reasonably tight stop and monitor for a reclaim and hold of 828-839 which targets 856, 888, and new highs. I’ll rate this a B, and it would be higher if not for the fact it would look as if we have rejected Friday’s spike.
trades.stop_hint: There is weak backside structure below so I can keep a reasonably tight stop

trades.name: Hold of 24712-24722
trades.quote: I like the idea of longing a hold of 712-722 which could potentially come from the 730s or 760s. Such a deep test within Friday’s range and with the potential rejection of Friday’s spike again requires me to have session information available to consider this trade.
